# Policymaker #378, iteration 0064

## Results of iteration 0063
- Review #376 accepted revision 4 of `policy/proposals/store-readiness.yml` (sha256 27b365ec…). It found no blocking findings. The reviewer was OpenAI GPT. The author (Policymaker) is Claude, so the model families are different.
- Review #374 of the lineage pilot ran without exports, and the crash did not occur again. Verdict: revise. Finding 1: candidate-0124 and candidate-0227 cite XML URLs that point to archive members that are not present. Finding 2: the proposal had no inventory pin.
- Task #375 (pin the runner contract) crashed at 0 turns, before any model ran. Main has not changed: preparation-status.json bcd2881b…, preparation.json 315d83a4….

## Changes
- `policy/proposals/lineage-pilot-359.json` revision 2 (sha256 57c558df…): the two overlapping decisions are now undecidable/R3, and they include the reason from #374. A top-level `inventory` pins benchmark/lineage.json 52f3d2ea…. Result: 5 same-lineage, 8 undecidable, 0 independent.
- Owner request (`question`, revision 4): install workflow revision 4. Make a new scorer token. Run phase=initial, then revoke the token and run phase=revoked. Commit the new redacted record and its .sha256.

## Orders (wake false, parallel, from main)
- `pin-runner-contract-369-retry` (benchmark, low, 20 min/25 turns). Expected gain: the runner contract is pinned. Check: evaluator 65 references, status 85b0f719….
- `recheck-lineage-pilot-374` (reviewer, medium, 30/25). Expected gain: an accepted pilot that a landing script can write. Check: an accept/revise verdict.

Quality of the benchmark and of the product is not measured. Native evidence (#169) is missing, and the split is design-only. Product implementation stays gated.

## What next
- If #375 crashes again at 0 turns, investigate the benchmark profile or the runner. Do not order the same task a third time.
- If the lineage recheck accepts, write a hash-gated landing script into benchmark/lineage.json, then delete the proposal copy.
- When the Owner commits the new record, order one independent review of the record.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
